reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes L1₂ precipitates form in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni alloys under the stated conditions; in this system, Al typically stabilizes BCC/B2 phases, and L1₂ is characteristic of Ni₃Al-type precipitates in Ni-based superalloys, not equiatomic or near-equiatomic HEA compositions.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but it is undermined by the implausibility of the starting material and expected microstructure, making the test irrelevant to the actual phase stability question.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of the phase equilibria in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni systems, leading researchers away from the actual BCC/FCC competition that governs properties.
